mapper.select: SELECT min(t.day_short_desc) as startDateStr, max(t.day_short_desc) as endDateStr, t.week_id as weekId, concat(t.week_long_desc,'(',substr(min(t.day_short_desc),6),'~', substr(max(t.day_short_desc),6),')') as fullName, t.year_id as yearId from bi_portal.sys_date t where 1=1 and t.year_id = '${year}' group by t.week_id, t.week_long_desc, t.year_id order by weekId

SELECT min(t.day_short_desc) as startDateStr, max(t.day_short_desc) as endDateStr, t.week_id as weekId, concat(t.week_long_desc,'(',substr(min(t.day_short_desc),6),'~', substr(max(t.day_short_desc),6),')') as fullName, t.year_id as yearId from bi_portal.sys_date t where 1=1 and t.day_short_desc = '${dateStr}' group by t.week_id, t.week_long_desc, t.year_id order by weekId
